column1: # German names of the countries outside Germany, one row per name: <ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code> TAB <name>.
# Hand-maintained input of scripts/build_gazetteer.py (Task 4, deviation 4); the build fails when a country of
# GeoNames' countryInfo.txt (other than DE) has no row here. A country may have several rows: the official
# short name plus the forms German postings use (Holland, UK, USA, the parts of the United Kingdom).
# Lines that start with # are comments. The names are plain facts; this file is not GeoNames data.
